note_en: 这样一来 sums up what came before and introduces its consequence: "this way, as a result." In 这样一来，宫廷菜的做法才没有完全失传 the word 才 adds "only because of that": the recipes survived only thanks to the chefs leaving the palace. English needs a whole phrase ("it was only because of this that...") to carry what 才 does in one character.
